# Love Auto Group

> Family-owned independent used car dealer in Villa Park, Illinois (DuPage County, west of Chicago). Selling used cars since 2014. Mostly Japanese makes: Lexus, Subaru, Acura, Honda, Mazda and Toyota, plus other makes. No dealer fees: buyers pay the price plus tax, title and license.

- Address: 735 N Yale Ave, Unit A, Villa Park, IL 60181
- Phone and text: (630) 359-3643
- Hours: Tuesday to Saturday, 2 PM to 6 PM. Closed Sunday and Monday. Other times by appointment.
- Illinois dealer license: DL5428
- Free CARFAX history report on every car that shows the CARFAX badge on its page.
- Financing for all credit levels, including through the buyer's own bank or credit union.
- We also buy cars and take trade-ins.

- [Current inventory](https://www.loveautogroup.net/inventory/): every car for sale, with price, mileage, VIN, photos and its own page. Prices and availability change daily; the car's own page is the current word.
